observed_anomalies.finding: world_random_state_ initial value is a fixed constant unrelated to seed_
observed_anomalies.detail: two different-seed sessions begin with identical loot/crit streams; divergence appears only after draw-count paths separate; comparison trials relying on 'different seed => different loot' are subtly wrong until first draw

observed_anomalies.finding: server tick cadence (150ms) is decoupled from core cadence (50ms) and from combat intervals (350/1200ms)
observed_anomalies.detail: swing/telegraph resolution granularity is bounded by poll timing, so identical command transcripts can produce different hit ordering depending on when polls land relative to now_ms
observed_anomalies.severity: high (for replay fidelity of tile-world combat)
